review_reason: Notable safety imbalances warrant expert review: 2 deaths vs 0 in placebo, numerically more cardiac SAEs in saxagliptin arm (cardiac failure, MI, ACS, coronary artery occlusion, myocardial ischaemia, angina pectoris), elevated urinary WBC abnormalities (30.43% vs 18.87%), and urinary blood abnormalities (4.71% vs 1.37%).
